conditions: Conditional Night-III death journey from the monks' cell via the scripted stair-foot stop and the book to Severinus's cell. This illustrative trace assumes the player has not moved or taken the book, so it remains at its initialized position; POS_LIBRO is player-dependent otherwise. The engine's first adjacent approach to the elevated book is (0x34,0x5c): the target stores height 0x13 while the walked terrain is height 0x0f. On arrival at destination 5 Berengario dies, his coordinates are reset to zero, and the phase advances; that disappearance/reposition is not a walked segment and is not drawn. Combined character/global search-door mask 0x1f; static floor geometry, no actor or door-leaf collisions.

note.es: Noche III: desde la celda de los monjes, Berengario pasa por el pie de las escaleras, recoge el libro y llega a la celda de Severino, donde muere. El trazado supone que el jugador no ha movido el libro.
note.en: Night III: from the monks' cell, Berengario goes via the stair foot, takes the book, and reaches Severinus's cell, where he dies. The trace assumes the player has not moved the book.
